pluginMetaData.name: ASTM E1381 Transmission Mode
pluginMetaData.author: Bit Dream IT
pluginMetaData.description: ASTM E1381-02 lower-layer transmission framing protocol, server side. Registers the ASTM E1381 StreamHandler with Mirth Connect TCP/Serial connectors. Implements ENQ/ACK/NAK establishment, STX/ETB/ETX framing, Add Mod 256 checksum, 0-7 frame sequencing, per-frame retry with exponential backoff, and per-phase timeouts.
